verdicts.flaw_description: The counts "cover the sessions that reached the new page" while "a quarter of each segment dropped out before checkout," so the 4-7 percent rise is measured only on the self-selected three-quarters that got as far as checkout. That is a narrower population than the claim, which is about purchases from the segment as a whole.

The figures "cover the runs with the upgraded filter in service" while "a quarter of each stack's runs were made with the filter bypassed," so the 8-14 percent reduction is computed on a selected three-quarters of runs rather than on the stack's particulate readings the claim is about.

The averages "cover the patients who kept up the home exercises" while "a quarter of each intake let the home exercises lapse," so the 9-16 degree gains come from the self-selected adherent three-quarters; adherence itself predicts recovery, and the excluded quarter is exactly the group that would drag the average down.

The rates "cover the trays sown from seed that took a full coat" while "about a fifth of each lot's trays were sown from partly coated seed," so the 6-11 point gain describes only the selected fully-coated four-fifths, not germination of the lot the coating was applied to.
